build_stft: build a python module that computes the short-time Fourier transform of an audio signal using JAX
build_istft: build a python module that reconstructs a time-domain signal from an STFT matrix using inverse STFT
build_spectrogram: build a python module that computes audio spectrograms from a waveform signal with configurable frame length and power
build_mel_spectrogram: build a python module that converts spectrograms to Mel-scale with optional log scaling for audio feature extraction
build_phase_vocoder: build a python module that speeds up an audio signal without changing pitch using the phase vocoder algorithm
